```
Task Package File Guide
=======================

1. Internet_Digital_Ark_Project.docx
   This is the official task brief for the Internet Digital Ark Project, emphasizing the design of an Automated/Autonomous/Intelligent Scientific Knowledge Discovery and Deep Research System. It explains the objectives for collecting historical domains from 1996 through 2001, year-specific evidence requirements, intelligent and autonomous discovery expectations, submission format, and the calculation and acceptance standard for Equivalent-English Domains. Please read it completely before beginning the task.

2. English_share_above_90pct_TLDs.txt
   This file lists the TLDs whose English primary-page-language shares exceed 90% in the Common Crawl model, with one TLD per line. It is intended to guide the prioritized discovery of domains with high equivalent-English conversion rates.

3. mergedyymmdd folder
   This folder contains the current domain archive. The files 1996.txt through 2001.txt are the official baseline to be expanded and used for comparison in this round, with one domain per line. New submissions must use the same yearly filenames and format. The auxiliary 2001-2014 lists and legacy merge statistics are retained for historical reference and candidate discovery; they are not part of the official 1996-2001 acceptance baseline.

4. equivalent_english_domain_calculator folder
   This folder contains the Equivalent-English Domain calculation tool. equivalent_english_domains.py is the main program, q2_tld_top_langs.json is the fixed CC-MAIN-2024-10 TLD English-share model, README.md provides usage instructions, and example_1998_results demonstrates the output format. Use the tool to calculate the baseline and submission Equivalent-English Domain totals, increment, and growth rate.
```
